usage: 鐵觀音 is a specific type of oolong tea known for its floral aroma and rich taste.
Use 鐵觀音 when you want to specify the tea variety you are drinking or serving.
In Cantonese sentences, 鐵觀音 usually functions as a noun and can appear as the subject or object.
You can say 我鍾意飲鐵觀音 to express liking this tea, or 啱啱煲咗啲鐵觀音 to describe freshly brewed iron buddha tea.
鐵觀音 can also be part of compound phrases, like 鐵觀音茶樓 (a teahouse specializing in iron buddha oolong tea).
